name: STJ Modules
author: Santi Jay
description: STJ Modules: Balatube modal percussion (balafon bar ↔ PVC tube) and Wizar Matrix keyboard mapper (46 keys + spacebar)

modules.name: Balatube
modules.description: Physically-modeled percussion voice: MATERIAL sweeps from an ebony balafon / marimba bar (wood) to a closed-pipe PVC tube hit (odd harmonics 1:3:5...). Six-mode modal resonator bank, jet flanger, overdrive/crunch, full per-knob CV, and a stereo external-audio processing bus.

modules.name: Wizar Matrix
modules.description: Map computer keyboard keys to VCV Rack parameters. 46 assignable keys plus spacebar. Momentary/toggle buttons, fader/rotary with height and velocity control, and parameter mapping mode.
